name: qwen_localization_teacher_v1
initialization: fresh native Qwen 2B rank8 LoRA; never initialize from earlier MIL

teacher.identity: same pinned native Qwen with LoRA disabled

loss.positive: teacher-gated BCE, mean within connected segments then mean across segments
loss.rank: teacher-gap hinge, retain 0.5 of confident teacher pair gaps
loss.normalization: equal total class mass; each train video once per epoch

validation.selection: highest real-dev within macro AUROC with video max AP >= zero-shot validation AP; zero shot epoch0 eligible

notes: new exploratory protocol; old formal results immutable
fixed 6-epoch ceiling is a budget, not evidence of convergence
short-video-biased dev selection documented in annotation artifact
selection BIC, normal 99th percentile and 25% soft coverage are preregistered initial choices, not validated optima
teacher ranks and threshold calibration never use temporal dev labels; those only select/stop checkpoints
